Subject: Recommendations of the Signal Review Panel (SRP) related to ChAdOx1 nCov.-
19 Corona Virus Vaccine (Recombinant) [COVISHIELD}- regarding.
References: Recommendations of the Signal Review Panel (SRP) related to COVID 19
Vaccines received to this office from Immunization division vide email dated 25.01.2023
Sir,

With reference to the subject cited above, this is to inform that the Signal Review Panel!
(SRP) for vaccines under Immunization Division of MoHFW has been set up to assess
information on potential vaccine Safety signals (routine and COVID-19 vaccines) using AEFI
Surveillance database.

Based on the evaluation of the AEF] related data and published medical literature
including Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) of Vaxzevria (ChAdOX Astrazeneca
Vaccine by global regulatory authorities such as UK-MHRA, European Medicines Agency
(EMA), Health Canada and TGA, Australia, SRP has made recommendation on inclusion of the

“following rare adverse events in the SmPC of ChAdOx4 nCoV-19 Corona Virus Vaccine
(Recombinant) [COVISHIELD]:
° "Very Rare: Cranial (Ill or VII) nerve palsy following vaccination with COVISHIELD" jn

Section ‘4.8 Undesirable effects’ of SmPC.,

° "Very Rare/ Unknown: Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) following vaccination with

COVISHIELD" in Section ‘4. 8 Undesirable effects’ of SmPC. .

This is being communicated to you to update the SmPC & Prescribing Information (P!) as per
recommendations of SRP and submit the same to this Directorate.
Yours faithfully,
. (Dr. V. G. Somani)
